Package com.tonic.analysis.source.parser

Interface ParseErrorListener

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    ParseErrorListener.CollectingErrorListener
    Functional Interface:
    This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
    @FunctionalInterface
public interface ParseErrorListener
    Callback the parser reports each error to, with factories for the throwing, collecting, logging and silent policies.
